Agent Name: Tickets_Pricing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: They introduced incorrect/unsupported annual pass pricing and, more importantly, treated memberships as per-person passes (separate adult and child pass prices) instead of using the museum’s family membership tiers. This violated the requirement to use accurate, up-to-date pricing and mis-modeled the pass structure, leading to an inflated annual pass total and the wrong savings conclusion. The later agents’ math was correct given these faulty inputs.
